artworks.title: Sibyl
artworks.artist: Bartolomeo Coriolano or Giuseppe Maria Moretti after Guido Reni
artworks.description: This print depicts a seated woman, with her body partially turned to the right and her face in profile, facing right. She has a long, straight nose, a strong brow, round eyes, and thin lips in a neutral expression, and her wavy hair is styled loosely around her head. She is wearing a draped garment, similar to a toga, which flows elegantly around her and bunches around her arms. The woman is holding a large blank tablet in her left hand, and her right elbow is resting on a piece of furniture. An inkwell with a quill inside it is on a surface next to her, on the right. One of her feet is visible below her garment, resting on what looks like a thick book. Behind her is a plain wall. The print contains thin white and black lines against a pale blue-gray background.

artworks.title: The Adoration of the Shepherds
artworks.description: This print shows multiple people in a complex scene. In the center, a woman looks down at an infant that is laid on a cloth on top of a table at the bottom of the print. On the left, three small, winged children look down at the child, smiling. On the right, a man sits or kneels beside the infant, his hands raised together as if in prayer. On the left, behind a column, another man with a wide hat looks down and smiles, holding a cylinder in his gloved hand. In the background are several other people, including a man holding long horns or trumpets and a smiling woman. The setting is full of tall arches and columns under the open sky, with a stone bridge and several buildings in the background. An angel flies in the sky at the top of the image. The print is made with light gray lines on an off-white background. In the bottom right, there are small dark brown spots of discoloration.

artworks.title: The Isolated Fort (Le Fort detache)
artworks.description: This print shows a low, hilly landscape with tall trees on the right and a distant building in the center. In the bottom left, three people are walking towards the distant building with their backs to us. The ground is covered in dark shading, and the sky is mostly blank except for a few low clouds. The print features loose, sketch-like gray lines on pale yellow paper.

artworks.title: Souvenir of Italy (Souvenir d'Italie)
artworks.description: This print shows a landscape with a low horizon line visible on the left, a domed building faintly visible in the distance beyond rolling hills. The right side is filled with tall, leafy trees. Swirling clouds are seen in the sky above the scene, and the ground is covered in dark, cross-hatched lines. There is a shape near the bottom left corner that might be a person, but it is hard to identify. There is a line of text below the bottom of the print. The background of the print is beige paper.

artworks.title: Little Shepherd, 1st Plate (Le Petit Berger)
artworks.description: The image shows a low-angle view of a dense cluster of trees with the horizon near the top center of the frame. A small clearing is visible, with a figure leaning against a tree to the right. The trees have fine, detailed brushstrokes showing intricate foliage and tree bark textures. The color palette is monochrome with sepia and brown tones, creating depth and contrast. Light and shadow are depicted subtly, adding to the serene and slightly mysterious atmosphere of the scene.

artworks.title: The Gardens of Horace (Les Jardins d'Horace)
artworks.description: The image depicts a wooden area. Trees and foliage arch above, framing the scene. In the foreground, there is a figure standing in tall grass. A dark shape, possibly an animal, is beside them. The trees and leaves form a canopy, almost hiding the sky. The horizon is not clear in the vertically-oriented composition. The color scheme is sepia, giving an aged look. The brushstrokes are detailed, emphasizing the texture of the woodland setting.

artworks.title: The Bell Tower of St. Nicolas-Lez-Arras (Le Clocher de St. Nicolas-Lez-Arras)
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with trees, a path, hills, and a building in the distance. The sketch is done in pencil on beige paper, creating a monochromatic scene with a soft, expressive style.

artworks.title: The Lonely Tower (La Tour isolee)
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape sketch with an elevated view, capturing a wide expanse of sky and land. A small structure or tower is on the horizon, with expressive black ink strokes, cross-hatching, and dynamic lines defining trees and clouds. The color palette is monochrome with black lines on light tan paper.

artworks.title: The Meeting in the Woods (La Rencontre du bosquet)
artworks.description: The image features a close perspective capturing a scene with figures, trees, and foliage. The charcoal drawing has a fluid and expressive quality with a monochrome color palette of tan and dark charcoal hues. There are figures in the foreground, surrounded by trees and foliage that extend upwards. In the distance, more foliage is visible.

artworks.title: The Rider in the Reeds (Le Cavalier dans les roseaux)
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with a house on the horizon, a person on horseback, and trees with twisted trunks. The sketch is done in graphite with expressive strokes creating texture. The color palette is charcoal and grey. There are undulations in the terrain and clouds in the sky.

artworks.title: The Gust of Wind (Le Coup de vent)
artworks.description: This image is a pencil sketch of a landscape featuring wind-swept trees, a figure on a path, a small structure, and a tower or windmill. The horizon line is high in the composition with expressive clouds in the sky. The sketch uses dynamic strokes to capture wind motion through the trees. The color palette is monochromatic, with shades of gray on beige paper.

artworks.title: The Philosophers' Retreat (Le Repos des Philosophes)
artworks.description: The image shows a forested area with slender trees surrounding a clearing. The trees have bare branches, and the view leads to a sunlit opening in the distance. There are figures near the trees, and one figure stands alone. The artwork is done in soft brushstrokes with a sepia tone, creating a warm and aged appearance. The scene has a balanced use of light and dark shades, emphasizing the natural elements.

artworks.title: Sappho (Sapho)
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape viewed from slightly above. The horizon is placed high in the composition, where the land meets distant hills and the sky. A silhouette of a figure is visible on the horizon. Loose and expressive brushstrokes create an impressionistic effect, with areas of shading and sketch-like lines for trees and foliage. The color palette is monochromatic, with varying shades of black and gray against a light background. In the foreground, a person is reclining on the ground, and large trees with textured crowns are to the left, with their branches stretching across the sky. The landscape gradually flattens towards the horizon.

artworks.title: Drowsing Cattle (Le Dormoir des vaches)
artworks.description: The image shows a ground-level view of a pastoral scene in sepia tones. The horizon is low, with a group of tall trees in the center. The trees are textured with vertical brushstrokes. The color palette is brown monochrome. There are grazing animals in the foreground. The brushwork is delicate and expressive, depicting the trees and landscape. In the background, the trees continue fading into the sky, with wispy clouds.

artworks.title: Souvenir of Italy (Souvenir d'Italie)
artworks.description: The image depicts a landscape with an elevated perspective, showing a rural scene. The horizon is in the upper third of the composition, with a slope leading to a building on a small hill to the right. Trees are spread out across the scene, with textured brushstrokes for foliage, adding movement and natural growth. The color palette is monochromatic, with sepia tones creating a warm atmosphere. Varied line density adds texture and depth to the image, enhancing its visual interest.

artworks.title: The Mill of Cuincy, near Douai (Le Moulin de Cuincy, pres Douai)
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with a focus on trees and a house. The viewpoint is from a low angle, and the horizon is above the midpoint. The house is in the distance among tall trees. The painting is done in a loose, sketch-like style with fine lines and shading for texture. The color scheme is mainly sepia tones. A lake in the foreground reflects the trees, guiding the viewer's focus towards the house. The sky in the background has soft lines hinting at clouds.

artworks.title: Family at Terracina (Une famille a terracine)
artworks.description: This image is a lithograph depicting several figures gathered on a grassy area surrounded by trees. The horizon is subtly suggested by distant landscape lines with leafless trees. The lines in the image are delicate and expressive, giving a sense of movement. The color palette is monochromatic in shades of brown and beige, creating a warm sepia tone. The sky is partially cloudy, and branches and leaves frame the image.

artworks.title: Willows and White Poplars (Saules et peupliers blancs)
artworks.description: The image shows a woodland scene depicted from ground level. The horizon is low, with undulating terrain and figure-like shapes in the distance. The drawing features swift, sketchy brushstrokes portraying trees of varying textures. The color palette is monochromatic with shades of brown. The ground shows textured strokes. The sky is mostly untouched.

artworks.title: John Frederic the Magnanimous, in Electoral Robes [left]
artworks.description: The image presents an upper-body illustration of a man seated in a formal portrait pose. His face has a rounded shape with prominent cheeks, a full mustache, and a short beard, and he looks straight ahead. He wears a large, ornate hat and a cloak with a fur-lined collar. In his hands, he holds a sword diagonally across his torso. The background features a plain light-colored surface with three heraldic shields and a decorative serif font Latin text below the illustration.

artworks.title: John Frederic the Magnanimous, in Electoral Robes [right]
artworks.description: The image is a woodcut illustration of a man from the waist up. He is holding a large sword, positioned slightly turned to his left. The man has a round face with a beard and mustache, and wears a hat covering most of his hair. He is dressed in a fur-lined cloak. Surrounding him are heraldic coats of arms. The background is a plain surface.

artworks.title: John Frederic the Magnanimous, in Electoral Robes
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of a man from the upper half of his body. He is seated and holds a large sword across his chest. The man has a bushy beard and mustache, with a stern face. He wears a fur-trimmed hat and his attire is elaborately designed with patterns and fur on his shoulders, matching his hat. There are multiple coats of arms surrounding him and an ornate border with heraldic symbols in the background. Latin text is included below the image.

artworks.title: John Frederic the Magnanimous, in Electoral Robes
artworks.description: The image depicts the upper body of a man holding a sword. He has a full beard and mustache, pronounced cheekbones, and a neutral expression. He wears a tall fur hat and a fur-trimmed cloak. The border around the figure has intricate patterns and coats of arms. The background contains decorative crests and text suggesting historical significance or lineage.

artworks.title: David and Abigail
artworks.description: The image shows two people and a small dog. One person is seated with turned shoulders, looking up at the standing person. The seated person wears a head covering and a detailed dress. A dog stands on its hind legs near the seated person. The standing figure wears elaborate armor and holds a lance or polearm. In the background, there are barren trees, a large tree trunk with a hanging branch, and a distant landscape with rolling hills and structures resembling a small town. Gloves and a hat are on the ground.

artworks.title: Marcus Curtius Plunging into the Chasm
artworks.description: This print features a detailed scene. In the center is a classical-style pavilion with arched openings and a domed roof adorned with intricate designs. A group of mostly-nude people is gathered around the pavilion, with one on horseback, holding a spear, and another holding a flag. In front of the pavilion, a knight on horseback appears to be falling into a dark hole in the ground. Vegetation, including trees and shrubs, is scattered throughout the landscape, and birds are seen flying in the sky above the pavilion. The horizon shows hills leading to a distant castle on a rocky formation on the right.
